title: The New Moab Gravel Adventure Field Guide
content:
There are few adventure travel destinations as iconic as Moab, Utah. It attracts mountain bikers from across the globe, and now invites gravel bike enthusiasts to do the same with the release of the newest edition in the Gravel Adventure Field Guide series.

This Moab gravel guidebook offers nearly 700 total miles of off-road adventure. The gravel bike offers another intimate way to experience the awe-inspiring natural beauty found within Moab’s rugged landscape. Even if you’re well acquainted with the legendary trails like Slick Rock, Porcupine Rim, and White Rim Trail, there’s more to the area to explore on overland desert roads. Moab always affords cyclists the chance for outdoor adventure.

Every visit to Moab has something for adventurous cyclists to find within the canyons, cliffs, and rocks. This Moab Gravel Adventure Field Guide highlights four-season opportunities to ride through the La Sal National Forest, Sand Flats Recreation Area, Horsethief Mesa, Hatch Point, and Beef Basin, and the Golden Grave Trail between Moab and Green River. This gravel guidebook includes tips for bikepacking, night-sky viewing, and birding.

The world only has one Moab. This Gravel Adventure Field Guide encourages adventure cyclists of all skill levels to explore its layers, mile by mile. This isn’t a destination that can be covered in a day—it can hardly be covered in a lifetime. Gravel bikes provide the magic ingredient for going deeper: for finding new trails, new roads, new viewpoints, and new ways to connect with the landscape.

You can find a Moab Gravel Adventure Field Guide at select bike shops listed on the Get One page. If residing outside a distribution zone, you can order one online.
